::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Psalms is the Bible's hymnbook, expressing worship, lament, thanksgiving, repentance, and praise. The book teaches that every human experience can be brought honestly before God in faith. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Psalm 1:1
Blessed is the man
### Why This Verse Opening wisdom psalm ### Chapter Insight This psalm contrasts the way of the righteous and the wicked. The key verse emphasizes that true blessing comes from delighting in God's Word. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Psalm 2:7
Thou art My Son
### Why This Verse Major messianic text quoted in the NT ### Chapter Insight This psalm proclaims God's sovereignty over earthly rulers. The key verse points to the Messiah's ultimate reign. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Psalm 3:3
Thou, O LORD, art a shield for me
### Why This Verse Classic trust verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses David's trust in God during adversity. The key verse emphasizes God as protector and sustainer. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Psalm 4:8
I will both lay me down in peace and sleep
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted comfort verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm contrasts peace from God with worldly anxiety. The key verse highlights the security found in God's presence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Psalm 5:3
My voice shalt Thou hear in the morning
### Why This Verse Morning prayer theme ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for guidance and protection. The key verse emphasizes God's delight in righteousness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Psalm 6:2
Have mercy upon me, O LORD
### Why This Verse Penitential prayer ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a cry for mercy during suffering. The key verse expresses dependence on God's compassion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Psalm 7:11
God judges the righteous
### Why This Verse Divine justice ### Chapter Insight This psalm appeals to God as righteous Judge. The key verse highlights God's justice toward the innocent and guilty. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Psalm 8:4
What is man, that Thou art mindful of him?
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted psalms ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's majesty revealed in creation. The key verse marvels at humanity's place within God's purposes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Psalm 9:10
They that know Thy name will trust in Thee
### Why This Verse Trust in God ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God for justice and deliverance. The key verse emphasizes God's care for the oppressed. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Psalm 10:17
Thou wilt hear the desire of the humble
### Why This Verse God's care for the oppressed ### Chapter Insight This psalm wrestles with the apparent success of the wicked. The key verse affirms God's concern for the afflicted. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Psalm 11:3
If the foundations be destroyed
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted cultural verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm encourages trust in God's righteous rule. The key verse reminds believers that God remains on His throne. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Psalm 12:6
The words of the LORD are pure words
### Why This Verse Scripture's purity ### Chapter Insight This psalm laments widespread dishonesty. The key verse celebrates the purity and reliability of God's words. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Psalm 13:5
I have trusted in Thy mercy
### Why This Verse Faith amid despair ### Chapter Insight This psalm moves from despair to trust. The key verse reflects confidence in God's steadfast love despite unanswered questions. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Psalm 14:1
The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God
### Why This Verse One of the best-known Psalms ### Chapter Insight This psalm describes humanity's moral corruption. The key verse identifies rejection of God as the root of foolishness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
Psalm 15:1
LORD, who shall abide in Thy tabernacle?
### Why This Verse Character of the righteous ### Chapter Insight This psalm describes the character of those who dwell with God. The key verse emphasizes integrity and righteousness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
Psalm 16:11
In Thy presence is fullness of joy
### Why This Verse Widely quoted promise ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses confidence in God's protection and eternal hope. The key verse points to resurrection and life beyond death. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
Psalm 17:8
Keep me as the apple of the eye
### Why This Verse Beloved prayer verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for vindication and protection. The key verse expresses satisfaction in God's presence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
Psalm 18:2
The LORD is my rock and my fortress
### Why This Verse One of David's most cited declarations ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's deliverance of David. The key verse identifies God as refuge, strength, and salvation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
Psalm 19:14
Let the words of my mouth
### Why This Verse Frequently used prayer before teaching/preaching ### Chapter Insight This psalm reveals God through creation and Scripture. The key verse highlights the perfection and transforming power of God's law. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
Psalm 20:7
Some trust in chariots
### Why This Verse Classic trust-in-God verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for victory and divine help. The key verse contrasts trust in God with reliance on human resources. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
Psalm 21:1
The king shall joy in Thy strength
### Why This Verse Royal thanksgiving ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's blessing upon the king. The key verse highlights joy found in God's strength. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
Psalm 22:1
My God, My God, why hast Thou forsaken Me?
### Why This Verse Quoted by Jesus on the cross ### Chapter Insight This psalm moves from suffering to triumph. The key verse prophetically points to Christ's crucifixion and ultimate victory. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
Psalm 23:1
The LORD is my shepherd
### Why This Verse Perhaps the most famous verse in the Bible ### Chapter Insight This psalm portrays God as the Good Shepherd. The key verse introduces the chapter's message of provision, guidance, and care. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
Psalm 24:1
The earth is the LORD's
### Why This Verse Foundational declaration of God's ownership ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's kingship and holiness. The key verse declares God's ownership of all creation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
Psalm 25:4
Show me Thy ways, O LORD
### Why This Verse Prayer for guidance ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for guidance, forgiveness, and protection. The key verse emphasizes trusting God in every circumstance. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 26
Psalm 26:2
Examine me, O LORD
### Why This Verse Prayer for divine testing ### Chapter Insight This psalm appeals for vindication based on integrity. The key verse expresses commitment to walk faithfully before God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 27
Psalm 27:1
The LORD is my light and my salvation
### Why This Verse One of the most beloved psalms ### Chapter Insight This psalm combines confidence and petition. The key verse declares God as the believer's light and salvation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 28
Psalm 28:7
The LORD is my strength and my shield
### Why This Verse Trust and thanksgiving ### Chapter Insight This psalm moves from prayer to praise. The key verse celebrates God as strength and shield. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 29
Psalm 29:2
Give unto the LORD the glory due His name
### Why This Verse Worship emphasis ### Chapter Insight This psalm exalts God's power displayed in creation. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereignty over all forces of nature. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 30
Psalm 30:5
Weeping may endure for a night
### Why This Verse Classic hope verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's deliverance and restoration. The key verse highlights God's ability to transform sorrow into joy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 31
Psalm 31:24
Be of good courage
### Why This Verse Encouragement to believers ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses trust in God amid distress and persecution. The key verse emphasizes committing one's life into God's faithful care. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 32
Psalm 32:1
Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven
### Why This Verse Foundational forgiveness text ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates the blessing of forgiveness. The key verse highlights the joy that comes from confessed and forgiven sin. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 33
Psalm 33:12
Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted national verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls God's people to praise His power and faithfulness. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereign rule over the nations. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 34
Psalm 34:8
Taste and see that the LORD is good
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted psalm verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's deliverance and goodness. The key verse invites believers to experience God's goodness personally. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 35
Psalm 35:27
Let the LORD be magnified
### Why This Verse Praise and vindication ### Chapter Insight This psalm appeals to God for justice against enemies. The key verse emphasizes God's role as defender of the innocent. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 36
Psalm 36:9
With Thee is the fountain of life
### Why This Verse Life and light in God ### Chapter Insight This psalm contrasts human wickedness with God's steadfast love. The key verse celebrates the abundance of God's mercy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 37
Psalm 37:4
Delight thyself also in the LORD
### Why This Verse Extremely popular promise verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm encourages patience when the wicked prosper. The key verse calls believers to delight in the Lord and trust His timing. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 38
Psalm 38:18
I will declare mine iniquity
### Why This Verse Repentance theme ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer of repentance and suffering. The key verse expresses dependence upon God's mercy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 39
Psalm 39:4
LORD, make me to know mine end
### Why This Verse Reflection on mortality ### Chapter Insight This psalm reflects on the brevity of life. The key verse emphasizes the temporary nature of earthly existence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 40
Psalm 40:1
I waited patiently for the LORD
### Why This Verse Famous testimony of deliverance ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's deliverance and faithful help. The key verse highlights delight in obeying God's will. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 41
Psalm 41:1
Blessed is he that considers the poor
### Why This Verse Compassion emphasized ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God for caring for the weak and afflicted. The key verse emphasizes God's blessing upon those who show compassion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 42
Psalm 42:1
As the deer pants for water
### Why This Verse One of the most recognized psalm verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses deep longing for God during spiritual dryness. The key verse portrays the soul's thirst for God's presence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 43
Psalm 43:3
Send out Thy light and Thy truth
### Why This Verse Prayer for guidance ### Chapter Insight This psalm continues the longing for restoration and fellowship with God. The key verse expresses hope despite discouragement. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 44
Psalm 44:22
For Thy sake we are killed all the day long
### Why This Verse Quoted in Romans 8 ### Chapter Insight This psalm laments suffering despite covenant faithfulness. The key verse appeals to God's steadfast love in difficult circumstances. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 45
Psalm 45:6
Thy throne, O God, is forever and ever
### Why This Verse Messianic verse quoted in Hebrews ### Chapter Insight This royal psalm celebrates the king and foreshadows the Messiah. The key verse points to the eternal throne of God's Anointed. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 46
Psalm 46:10
Be still, and know that I am God
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted verses in Scripture ### Chapter Insight This psalm proclaims God as refuge amid turmoil. The key verse calls believers to trust God's sovereign control. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 47
Psalm 47:1
O clap your hands, all ye people
### Why This Verse Celebratory worship ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's kingship over all nations. The key verse emphasizes God's universal reign. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 48
Psalm 48:1
Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised
### Why This Verse Zion praise psalm ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God's protection of Zion. The key verse highlights God's enduring guidance and faithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 49
Psalm 49:15
God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave
### Why This Verse Hope ### Chapter Insight This psalm warns against trusting in wealth. The key verse teaches that riches cannot redeem a soul. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 50
Psalm 50:15
Call upon Me in the day of trouble
### Why This Verse Divine invitation and promise ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls for genuine worship and obedience. The key verse emphasizes thanksgiving and faithful living over empty ritual. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 51
Psalm 51:10
Create in me a clean heart
### Why This Verse Most famous repentance verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm records David's repentance after his sin with Bathsheba. The key verse expresses the desire for a clean heart and renewed spirit. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 52
Psalm 52:8
I am like a green olive tree
### Why This Verse Trust in God's mercy ### Chapter Insight This psalm contrasts evil boasting with trust in God's love. The key verse emphasizes confidence in God's steadfast mercy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 53
Psalm 53:1
The fool hath said in his heart
### Why This Verse Repetition of Psalm 14's theme ### Chapter Insight This psalm describes humanity's corruption apart from God. The key verse identifies denial of God as the essence of folly. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 54
Psalm 54:4
God is my helper
### Why This Verse Confidence in divine aid ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for deliverance from enemies. The key verse highlights God's role as helper and sustainer. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 55
Psalm 55:22
Cast thy burden upon the LORD
### Why This Verse Widely quoted comfort verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses betrayal and sorrow. The key verse encourages casting every burden upon the Lord. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 56
Psalm 56:3
What time I am afraid, I will trust in Thee
### Why This Verse Faith over fear ### Chapter Insight This psalm demonstrates trust amid fear and opposition. The key verse teaches reliance upon God instead of fear. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 57
Psalm 57:1
Under the shadow of Thy wings
### Why This Verse Refuge in God ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God while seeking refuge during danger. The key verse emphasizes God's exaltation above all circumstances. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 58
Psalm 58:3
The wicked are estranged from the womb
### Why This Verse Human depravity theme ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls for divine justice against wicked rulers. The key verse affirms that God judges righteously. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 59
Psalm 59:16
I will sing of Thy power
### Why This Verse Praise amid danger ### Chapter Insight This psalm seeks God's protection from violent enemies. The key verse highlights God as refuge and strength. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 60
Psalm 60:12
Through God we shall do valiantly
### Why This Verse Victory through God ### Chapter Insight This psalm prays for restoration after national defeat. The key verse expresses confidence that victory comes through God alone. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 61
Psalm 61:2
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I
### Why This Verse Beloved prayer verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for refuge and security. The key verse expresses confidence in God as a shelter in times of distress. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 62
Psalm 62:1
Truly my soul waits upon God
### Why This Verse Quiet trust ### Chapter Insight This psalm emphasizes waiting quietly upon God. The key verse teaches that true rest and salvation are found in Him alone. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 63
Psalm 63:1
O God, Thou art my God
### Why This Verse One of the great devotion psalms ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses deep longing for God. The key verse portrays wholehearted pursuit of God's presence above all else. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 64
Psalm 64:10
The righteous shall be glad in the LORD
### Why This Verse Trust after deliverance ### Chapter Insight This psalm seeks protection from hidden enemies. The key verse highlights God's ability to expose evil and vindicate the righteous. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 65
Psalm 65:2
O Thou that hearest prayer
### Why This Verse Universal invitation to prayer ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's provision in creation and grace. The key verse emphasizes God's power to satisfy and bless His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 66
Psalm 66:18
If I regard iniquity in my heart
### Why This Verse Often cited regarding prayer ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls all nations to praise God. The key verse highlights God's faithfulness demonstrated through answered prayer. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 67
Psalm 67:1
God be merciful unto us and bless us
### Why This Verse Mission and blessing ### Chapter Insight This psalm prays for God's blessing to reach all peoples. The key verse connects divine blessing with a global witness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 68
Psalm 68:19
Blessed be the Lord, who daily loads us with benefits
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted praise verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's victorious reign. The key verse emphasizes God's care for the vulnerable and His triumph over enemies. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 69
Psalm 69:9
Zeal for Thy house hath consumed me
### Why This Verse Quoted regarding Christ ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a lament that contains significant messianic themes. The key verse points to Christ's zeal for God's house. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 70
Psalm 70:4
Let God be magnified
### Why This Verse Worship emphasis ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a brief cry for urgent help. The key verse expresses dependence upon God's immediate intervention. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 71
Psalm 71:18
When I am old and grayheaded
### Why This Verse Faithfulness across generations ### Chapter Insight This psalm reflects lifelong trust in God. The key verse emphasizes God's faithfulness from youth through old age. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 72
Psalm 72:18
Blessed be the LORD God of Israel
### Why This Verse Doxology ### Chapter Insight This royal psalm prays for a righteous king. The key verse points beyond Solomon to the universal reign of the Messiah. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 73
Psalm 73:26
My flesh and my heart fail
### Why This Verse One of the most beloved psalm verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm wrestles with the prosperity of the wicked. The key verse reveals that God's presence is the believer's greatest good. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 74
Psalm 74:12
God is my King of old
### Why This Verse Hope amid national distress ### Chapter Insight This psalm laments national devastation. The key verse appeals to God to remember His covenant people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 75
Psalm 75:7
God is the Judge
### Why This Verse Divine sovereignty ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's righteous judgment. The key verse affirms that God alone determines exaltation and downfall. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 76
Psalm 76:10
The wrath of man shall praise Thee
### Why This Verse God's sovereignty over evil ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God's power over nations and armies. The key verse highlights God's ability to bring peace through His authority. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 77
Psalm 77:11
I will remember the works of the LORD
### Why This Verse Faith through remembrance ### Chapter Insight This psalm moves from despair to remembrance. The key verse finds hope by recalling God's mighty works. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 78
Psalm 78:4
We will not hide them from their children
### Why This Verse Passing faith to future generations ### Chapter Insight This psalm reviews Israel's history as a lesson for future generations. The key verse emphasizes teaching God's deeds to children. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 79
Psalm 79:9
Help us, O God of our salvation
### Why This Verse National prayer for mercy ### Chapter Insight This psalm laments Jerusalem's destruction. The key verse appeals to God's mercy amid judgment. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 80
Psalm 80:3
Turn us again, O God
### Why This Verse Repeated refrain ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for restoration. The key verse repeatedly asks God to restore His people and shine upon them. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 81
Psalm 81:10
Open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it
### Why This Verse Promise of divine provision ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls Israel to worship and obedience. The key verse highlights God's desire to bless those who listen to Him. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 82
Psalm 82:6
Ye are gods
### Why This Verse Quoted by Jesus in John 10 ### Chapter Insight This psalm rebukes unjust rulers. The key verse emphasizes God's concern for justice and protection of the vulnerable. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 83
Psalm 83:18
That men may know that Thou alone art the Most High
### Why This Verse God's supremacy ### Chapter Insight This psalm seeks deliverance from hostile nations. The key verse desires that all people recognize God's supremacy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 84
Psalm 84:11
No good thing will He withhold
### Why This Verse One of the Psalter's most beloved promises ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates the joy of dwelling in God's presence. The key verse expresses the blessedness of trusting in God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 85
Psalm 85:10
Mercy and truth are met together
### Why This Verse Beautiful redemption imagery ### Chapter Insight This psalm prays for revival and restoration. The key verse celebrates the meeting of God's mercy and truth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 86
Psalm 86:15
Thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion
### Why This Verse Divine character ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a personal prayer for mercy and guidance. The key verse highlights God's compassion and readiness to forgive. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 87
Psalm 87:3
Glorious things are spoken of thee
### Why This Verse Famous Zion verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates Zion's special place in God's purposes. The key verse anticipates people from all nations belonging to God's city. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 88
Psalm 88:18
Darkness is my closest companion
### Why This Verse Notable lament conclusion ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a lament from the depths of suffering. The key verse demonstrates persistence in prayer even without immediate relief. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 89
Psalm 89:34
My covenant will I not break
### Why This Verse Covenant faithfulness ### Chapter Insight This psalm reflects on God's covenant with David. The key verse emphasizes God's enduring faithfulness despite present difficulties. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 90
Psalm 90:12
Teach us to number our days
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted wisdom verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm, written by Moses, reflects on God's eternity and human frailty. The key verse calls for wisdom in light of life's brevity. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 91
Psalm 91:1
He that dwelleth in the secret place
### Why This Verse Perhaps the most cited protection psalm ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's protection for those who trust Him. The key verse emphasizes security found in dwelling under God's care. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 92
Psalm 92:12
The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree
### Why This Verse Spiritual growth imagery ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God for His faithfulness and righteous rule. The key verse highlights the flourishing of the righteous in God's presence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 93
Psalm 93:1
The LORD reigneth
### Why This Verse Central theme of the psalm ### Chapter Insight This psalm proclaims the Lord's sovereign reign. The key verse emphasizes God's eternal stability and authority. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 94
Psalm 94:19
In the multitude of my thoughts within me
### Why This Verse Comfort in anxiety ### Chapter Insight This psalm appeals to God for justice against the wicked. The key verse affirms that God disciplines and teaches His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 95
Psalm 95:6
O come, let us worship and bow down
### Why This Verse Classic call to worship ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls God's people to worship and obedience. The key verse warns against hardening the heart toward God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 96
Psalm 96:3
Declare His glory among the nations
### Why This Verse Missions emphasis ### Chapter Insight This psalm invites all nations to worship the Lord. The key verse proclaims God's glory among the peoples of the earth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 97
Psalm 97:10
Ye that love the LORD, hate evil
### Why This Verse Moral exhortation ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's universal kingship. The key verse emphasizes joy for those who love righteousness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 98
Psalm 98:4
Make a joyful noise unto the LORD
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted worship verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God for His salvation and righteous judgment. The key verse calls creation itself to rejoice before the Lord. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 99
Psalm 99:5
Exalt ye the LORD our God
### Why This Verse Worship and holiness ### Chapter Insight This psalm exalts God's holiness and justice. The key verse emphasizes worship before a holy God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 100
Psalm 100:4
Enter into His gates with thanksgiving
### Why This Verse One of the most beloved worship verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a joyful call to worship. The key verse celebrates God's goodness, love, and faithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 101
Psalm 101:3
I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes
### Why This Verse Personal holiness ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses commitment to righteous leadership. The key verse highlights integrity in both private and public life. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 102
Psalm 102:25
Of old hast Thou laid the foundation of the earth
### Why This Verse Quoted in Hebrews ### Chapter Insight This psalm contrasts human frailty with God's permanence. The key verse emphasizes God's unchanging nature. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 103
Psalm 103:12
As far as the east is from the west
### Why This Verse One of the most beloved forgiveness verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's mercy and compassion. The key verse calls believers to remember and praise God's benefits. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 104
Psalm 104:24
O LORD, how manifold are Thy works
### Why This Verse Praise for creation ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God as Creator and Sustainer. The key verse highlights God's wisdom displayed throughout creation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 105
Psalm 105:4
Seek the LORD and His strength
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted exhortation ### Chapter Insight This psalm recounts God's faithfulness throughout Israel's history. The key verse emphasizes remembering God's mighty deeds. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 106
Psalm 106:1
O give thanks unto the LORD; for He is good
### Why This Verse Classic praise formula ### Chapter Insight This psalm confesses Israel's repeated failures. The key verse highlights God's mercy despite continual rebellion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 107
Psalm 107:1
O give thanks unto the LORD; for He is good
### Why This Verse Opening thanksgiving refrain ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's deliverance in many circumstances. The key verse calls the redeemed to give thanks for God's goodness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 108
Psalm 108:13
Through God we shall do valiantly
### Why This Verse Victory through God ### Chapter Insight This psalm combines praise and confidence in God's help. The key verse expresses steadfast trust in God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 109
Psalm 109:4
I give myself unto prayer
### Why This Verse David's response to enemies ### Chapter Insight This psalm appeals for justice amid severe opposition. The key verse demonstrates dependence upon God in the face of hostility. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 110
Psalm 110:1
The LORD said unto my Lord
### Why This Verse Most quoted OT verse in the NT ### Chapter Insight This psalm presents the Messiah as King and Priest. The key verse is one of the most frequently quoted Old Testament verses in the New Testament. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 111
Psalm 111:10
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom
### Why This Verse Foundational wisdom text ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God's works and character. The key verse identifies reverence for God as the beginning of wisdom. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 112
Psalm 112:7
He shall not be afraid of evil tidings
### Why This Verse Trust amid uncertainty ### Chapter Insight This psalm describes the blessings of the righteous. The key verse emphasizes stability rooted in trust in God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 113
Psalm 113:3
From the rising of the sun
### Why This Verse Universal praise ### Chapter Insight This psalm exalts God for His greatness and compassion. The key verse highlights God's care for the humble. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 114
Psalm 114:7
Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord
### Why This Verse God's power displayed ### Chapter Insight This psalm recalls God's power during the Exodus. The key verse celebrates God's presence among His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 115
Psalm 115:1
Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us

I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills
### Why This Verse One of the most beloved pilgrimage psalms ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses confidence in God's continual protection. The key verse emphasizes that help comes from the Lord, the Creator of heaven and earth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 122

Pray for the peace of Jerusalem
### Why This Verse Widely quoted prayer verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates worship in Jerusalem. The key verse highlights the joy of gathering with God's people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 123

Our eyes wait upon the Lord
### Why This Verse Dependence upon God's mercy ### Chapter Insight This psalm looks to God for mercy amid contempt and opposition. The key verse illustrates humble dependence upon God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 124

Our help is in the name of the Lord

They that trust in the LORD shall be as Mount Zion
### Why This Verse Stability through faith ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates the security of those who trust in God. The key verse compares believers to Mount Zion, steadfast and unshaken. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 126

### Why This Verse Classic hope and restoration verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm rejoices in God's restoration of His people. The key verse reflects joy when God reverses seasons of hardship. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 127

Except the LORD build the house
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted family/work verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm teaches dependence upon God's blessing. The key verse reminds believers that labor is futile apart from the Lord. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 128

Blessed is every one that fears the LORD
### Why This Verse Family blessing psalm ### Chapter Insight This psalm describes the blessings of fearing the Lord. The key verse emphasizes the fruitfulness of a God-centered life. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 129

I have quieted my soul

How good and pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity
### Why This Verse Most famous unity verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates unity among God's people. The key verse highlights the beauty and blessing of harmony. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 134

His mercy endureth forever

### Why This Verse Popular promise verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm gives thanks for God's faithfulness. The key verse celebrates God's exaltation of His word and name. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 139

# Psalms ::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Psalms is the Bible's hymnbook, expressing worship, lament, thanksgiving, repentance, and praise. The book teaches that every human experience can be brought honestly before God in faith. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Psalm 1:1
Blessed is the man
### Why This Verse Opening wisdom psalm ### Chapter Insight This psalm contrasts the way of the righteous and the wicked. The key verse emphasizes that true blessing comes from delighting in God's Word. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Psalm 2:7
Thou art My Son
### Why This Verse Major messianic text quoted in the NT ### Chapter Insight This psalm proclaims God's sovereignty over earthly rulers. The key verse points to the Messiah's ultimate reign. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Psalm 3:3
Thou, O LORD, art a shield for me
### Why This Verse Classic trust verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses David's trust in God during adversity. The key verse emphasizes God as protector and sustainer. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Psalm 4:8
I will both lay me down in peace and sleep
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted comfort verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm contrasts peace from God with worldly anxiety. The key verse highlights the security found in God's presence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Psalm 5:3
My voice shalt Thou hear in the morning
### Why This Verse Morning prayer theme ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for guidance and protection. The key verse emphasizes God's delight in righteousness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Psalm 6:2
Have mercy upon me, O LORD
### Why This Verse Penitential prayer ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a cry for mercy during suffering. The key verse expresses dependence on God's compassion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Psalm 7:11
God judges the righteous
### Why This Verse Divine justice ### Chapter Insight This psalm appeals to God as righteous Judge. The key verse highlights God's justice toward the innocent and guilty. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Psalm 8:4
What is man, that Thou art mindful of him?
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted psalms ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's majesty revealed in creation. The key verse marvels at humanity's place within God's purposes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Psalm 9:10
They that know Thy name will trust in Thee
### Why This Verse Trust in God ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God for justice and deliverance. The key verse emphasizes God's care for the oppressed. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Psalm 10:17
Thou wilt hear the desire of the humble
### Why This Verse God's care for the oppressed ### Chapter Insight This psalm wrestles with the apparent success of the wicked. The key verse affirms God's concern for the afflicted. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Psalm 11:3
If the foundations be destroyed
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted cultural verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm encourages trust in God's righteous rule. The key verse reminds believers that God remains on His throne. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Psalm 12:6
The words of the LORD are pure words
### Why This Verse Scripture's purity ### Chapter Insight This psalm laments widespread dishonesty. The key verse celebrates the purity and reliability of God's words. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Psalm 13:5
I have trusted in Thy mercy
### Why This Verse Faith amid despair ### Chapter Insight This psalm moves from despair to trust. The key verse reflects confidence in God's steadfast love despite unanswered questions. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Psalm 14:1
The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God
### Why This Verse One of the best-known Psalms ### Chapter Insight This psalm describes humanity's moral corruption. The key verse identifies rejection of God as the root of foolishness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
Psalm 15:1
LORD, who shall abide in Thy tabernacle?
### Why This Verse Character of the righteous ### Chapter Insight This psalm describes the character of those who dwell with God. The key verse emphasizes integrity and righteousness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
Psalm 16:11
In Thy presence is fullness of joy
### Why This Verse Widely quoted promise ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses confidence in God's protection and eternal hope. The key verse points to resurrection and life beyond death. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
Psalm 17:8
Keep me as the apple of the eye
### Why This Verse Beloved prayer verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for vindication and protection. The key verse expresses satisfaction in God's presence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
Psalm 18:2
The LORD is my rock and my fortress
### Why This Verse One of David's most cited declarations ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's deliverance of David. The key verse identifies God as refuge, strength, and salvation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
Psalm 19:14
Let the words of my mouth
### Why This Verse Frequently used prayer before teaching/preaching ### Chapter Insight This psalm reveals God through creation and Scripture. The key verse highlights the perfection and transforming power of God's law. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
Psalm 20:7
Some trust in chariots
### Why This Verse Classic trust-in-God verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for victory and divine help. The key verse contrasts trust in God with reliance on human resources. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
Psalm 21:1
The king shall joy in Thy strength
### Why This Verse Royal thanksgiving ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's blessing upon the king. The key verse highlights joy found in God's strength. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
Psalm 22:1
My God, My God, why hast Thou forsaken Me?
### Why This Verse Quoted by Jesus on the cross ### Chapter Insight This psalm moves from suffering to triumph. The key verse prophetically points to Christ's crucifixion and ultimate victory. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
Psalm 23:1
The LORD is my shepherd
### Why This Verse Perhaps the most famous verse in the Bible ### Chapter Insight This psalm portrays God as the Good Shepherd. The key verse introduces the chapter's message of provision, guidance, and care. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
Psalm 24:1
The earth is the LORD's
### Why This Verse Foundational declaration of God's ownership ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's kingship and holiness. The key verse declares God's ownership of all creation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
Psalm 25:4
Show me Thy ways, O LORD
### Why This Verse Prayer for guidance ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for guidance, forgiveness, and protection. The key verse emphasizes trusting God in every circumstance. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 26
Psalm 26:2
Examine me, O LORD
### Why This Verse Prayer for divine testing ### Chapter Insight This psalm appeals for vindication based on integrity. The key verse expresses commitment to walk faithfully before God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 27
Psalm 27:1
The LORD is my light and my salvation
### Why This Verse One of the most beloved psalms ### Chapter Insight This psalm combines confidence and petition. The key verse declares God as the believer's light and salvation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 28
Psalm 28:7
The LORD is my strength and my shield
### Why This Verse Trust and thanksgiving ### Chapter Insight This psalm moves from prayer to praise. The key verse celebrates God as strength and shield. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 29
Psalm 29:2
Give unto the LORD the glory due His name
### Why This Verse Worship emphasis ### Chapter Insight This psalm exalts God's power displayed in creation. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereignty over all forces of nature. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 30
Psalm 30:5
Weeping may endure for a night
### Why This Verse Classic hope verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's deliverance and restoration. The key verse highlights God's ability to transform sorrow into joy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 31
Psalm 31:24
Be of good courage
### Why This Verse Encouragement to believers ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses trust in God amid distress and persecution. The key verse emphasizes committing one's life into God's faithful care. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 32
Psalm 32:1
Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven
### Why This Verse Foundational forgiveness text ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates the blessing of forgiveness. The key verse highlights the joy that comes from confessed and forgiven sin. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 33
Psalm 33:12
Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted national verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls God's people to praise His power and faithfulness. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereign rule over the nations. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 34
Psalm 34:8
Taste and see that the LORD is good
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted psalm verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's deliverance and goodness. The key verse invites believers to experience God's goodness personally. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 35
Psalm 35:27
Let the LORD be magnified
### Why This Verse Praise and vindication ### Chapter Insight This psalm appeals to God for justice against enemies. The key verse emphasizes God's role as defender of the innocent. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 36
Psalm 36:9
With Thee is the fountain of life
### Why This Verse Life and light in God ### Chapter Insight This psalm contrasts human wickedness with God's steadfast love. The key verse celebrates the abundance of God's mercy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 37
Psalm 37:4
Delight thyself also in the LORD
### Why This Verse Extremely popular promise verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm encourages patience when the wicked prosper. The key verse calls believers to delight in the Lord and trust His timing. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 38
Psalm 38:18
I will declare mine iniquity
### Why This Verse Repentance theme ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer of repentance and suffering. The key verse expresses dependence upon God's mercy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 39
Psalm 39:4
LORD, make me to know mine end
### Why This Verse Reflection on mortality ### Chapter Insight This psalm reflects on the brevity of life. The key verse emphasizes the temporary nature of earthly existence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 40
Psalm 40:1
I waited patiently for the LORD
### Why This Verse Famous testimony of deliverance ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's deliverance and faithful help. The key verse highlights delight in obeying God's will. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 41
Psalm 41:1
Blessed is he that considers the poor
### Why This Verse Compassion emphasized ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God for caring for the weak and afflicted. The key verse emphasizes God's blessing upon those who show compassion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 42
Psalm 42:1
As the deer pants for water
### Why This Verse One of the most recognized psalm verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses deep longing for God during spiritual dryness. The key verse portrays the soul's thirst for God's presence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 43
Psalm 43:3
Send out Thy light and Thy truth
### Why This Verse Prayer for guidance ### Chapter Insight This psalm continues the longing for restoration and fellowship with God. The key verse expresses hope despite discouragement. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 44
Psalm 44:22
For Thy sake we are killed all the day long
### Why This Verse Quoted in Romans 8 ### Chapter Insight This psalm laments suffering despite covenant faithfulness. The key verse appeals to God's steadfast love in difficult circumstances. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 45
Psalm 45:6
Thy throne, O God, is forever and ever
### Why This Verse Messianic verse quoted in Hebrews ### Chapter Insight This royal psalm celebrates the king and foreshadows the Messiah. The key verse points to the eternal throne of God's Anointed. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 46
Psalm 46:10
Be still, and know that I am God
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted verses in Scripture ### Chapter Insight This psalm proclaims God as refuge amid turmoil. The key verse calls believers to trust God's sovereign control. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 47
Psalm 47:1
O clap your hands, all ye people
### Why This Verse Celebratory worship ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's kingship over all nations. The key verse emphasizes God's universal reign. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 48
Psalm 48:1
Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised
### Why This Verse Zion praise psalm ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God's protection of Zion. The key verse highlights God's enduring guidance and faithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 49
Psalm 49:15
God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave
### Why This Verse Hope ### Chapter Insight This psalm warns against trusting in wealth. The key verse teaches that riches cannot redeem a soul. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 50
Psalm 50:15
Call upon Me in the day of trouble
### Why This Verse Divine invitation and promise ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls for genuine worship and obedience. The key verse emphasizes thanksgiving and faithful living over empty ritual. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 51
Psalm 51:10
Create in me a clean heart
### Why This Verse Most famous repentance verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm records David's repentance after his sin with Bathsheba. The key verse expresses the desire for a clean heart and renewed spirit. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 52
Psalm 52:8
I am like a green olive tree
### Why This Verse Trust in God's mercy ### Chapter Insight This psalm contrasts evil boasting with trust in God's love. The key verse emphasizes confidence in God's steadfast mercy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 53
Psalm 53:1
The fool hath said in his heart
### Why This Verse Repetition of Psalm 14's theme ### Chapter Insight This psalm describes humanity's corruption apart from God. The key verse identifies denial of God as the essence of folly. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 54
Psalm 54:4
God is my helper
### Why This Verse Confidence in divine aid ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for deliverance from enemies. The key verse highlights God's role as helper and sustainer. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 55
Psalm 55:22
Cast thy burden upon the LORD
### Why This Verse Widely quoted comfort verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses betrayal and sorrow. The key verse encourages casting every burden upon the Lord. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 56
Psalm 56:3
What time I am afraid, I will trust in Thee
### Why This Verse Faith over fear ### Chapter Insight This psalm demonstrates trust amid fear and opposition. The key verse teaches reliance upon God instead of fear. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 57
Psalm 57:1
Under the shadow of Thy wings
### Why This Verse Refuge in God ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God while seeking refuge during danger. The key verse emphasizes God's exaltation above all circumstances. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 58
Psalm 58:3
The wicked are estranged from the womb
### Why This Verse Human depravity theme ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls for divine justice against wicked rulers. The key verse affirms that God judges righteously. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 59
Psalm 59:16
I will sing of Thy power
### Why This Verse Praise amid danger ### Chapter Insight This psalm seeks God's protection from violent enemies. The key verse highlights God as refuge and strength. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 60
Psalm 60:12
Through God we shall do valiantly
### Why This Verse Victory through God ### Chapter Insight This psalm prays for restoration after national defeat. The key verse expresses confidence that victory comes through God alone. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 61
Psalm 61:2
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I
### Why This Verse Beloved prayer verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for refuge and security. The key verse expresses confidence in God as a shelter in times of distress. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 62
Psalm 62:1
Truly my soul waits upon God
### Why This Verse Quiet trust ### Chapter Insight This psalm emphasizes waiting quietly upon God. The key verse teaches that true rest and salvation are found in Him alone. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 63
Psalm 63:1
O God, Thou art my God
### Why This Verse One of the great devotion psalms ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses deep longing for God. The key verse portrays wholehearted pursuit of God's presence above all else. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 64
Psalm 64:10
The righteous shall be glad in the LORD
### Why This Verse Trust after deliverance ### Chapter Insight This psalm seeks protection from hidden enemies. The key verse highlights God's ability to expose evil and vindicate the righteous. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 65
Psalm 65:2
O Thou that hearest prayer
### Why This Verse Universal invitation to prayer ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's provision in creation and grace. The key verse emphasizes God's power to satisfy and bless His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 66
Psalm 66:18
If I regard iniquity in my heart
### Why This Verse Often cited regarding prayer ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls all nations to praise God. The key verse highlights God's faithfulness demonstrated through answered prayer. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 67
Psalm 67:1
God be merciful unto us and bless us
### Why This Verse Mission and blessing ### Chapter Insight This psalm prays for God's blessing to reach all peoples. The key verse connects divine blessing with a global witness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 68
Psalm 68:19
Blessed be the Lord, who daily loads us with benefits
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted praise verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's victorious reign. The key verse emphasizes God's care for the vulnerable and His triumph over enemies. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 69
Psalm 69:9
Zeal for Thy house hath consumed me
### Why This Verse Quoted regarding Christ ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a lament that contains significant messianic themes. The key verse points to Christ's zeal for God's house. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 70
Psalm 70:4
Let God be magnified
### Why This Verse Worship emphasis ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a brief cry for urgent help. The key verse expresses dependence upon God's immediate intervention. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 71
Psalm 71:18
When I am old and grayheaded
### Why This Verse Faithfulness across generations ### Chapter Insight This psalm reflects lifelong trust in God. The key verse emphasizes God's faithfulness from youth through old age. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 72
Psalm 72:18
Blessed be the LORD God of Israel
### Why This Verse Doxology ### Chapter Insight This royal psalm prays for a righteous king. The key verse points beyond Solomon to the universal reign of the Messiah. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 73
Psalm 73:26
My flesh and my heart fail
### Why This Verse One of the most beloved psalm verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm wrestles with the prosperity of the wicked. The key verse reveals that God's presence is the believer's greatest good. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 74
Psalm 74:12
God is my King of old
### Why This Verse Hope amid national distress ### Chapter Insight This psalm laments national devastation. The key verse appeals to God to remember His covenant people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 75
Psalm 75:7
God is the Judge
### Why This Verse Divine sovereignty ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's righteous judgment. The key verse affirms that God alone determines exaltation and downfall. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 76
Psalm 76:10
The wrath of man shall praise Thee
### Why This Verse God's sovereignty over evil ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God's power over nations and armies. The key verse highlights God's ability to bring peace through His authority. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 77
Psalm 77:11
I will remember the works of the LORD
### Why This Verse Faith through remembrance ### Chapter Insight This psalm moves from despair to remembrance. The key verse finds hope by recalling God's mighty works. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 78
Psalm 78:4
We will not hide them from their children
### Why This Verse Passing faith to future generations ### Chapter Insight This psalm reviews Israel's history as a lesson for future generations. The key verse emphasizes teaching God's deeds to children. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 79
Psalm 79:9
Help us, O God of our salvation
### Why This Verse National prayer for mercy ### Chapter Insight This psalm laments Jerusalem's destruction. The key verse appeals to God's mercy amid judgment. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 80
Psalm 80:3
Turn us again, O God
### Why This Verse Repeated refrain ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for restoration. The key verse repeatedly asks God to restore His people and shine upon them. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 81
Psalm 81:10
Open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it
### Why This Verse Promise of divine provision ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls Israel to worship and obedience. The key verse highlights God's desire to bless those who listen to Him. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 82
Psalm 82:6
Ye are gods
### Why This Verse Quoted by Jesus in John 10 ### Chapter Insight This psalm rebukes unjust rulers. The key verse emphasizes God's concern for justice and protection of the vulnerable. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 83
Psalm 83:18
That men may know that Thou alone art the Most High
### Why This Verse God's supremacy ### Chapter Insight This psalm seeks deliverance from hostile nations. The key verse desires that all people recognize God's supremacy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 84
Psalm 84:11
No good thing will He withhold
### Why This Verse One of the Psalter's most beloved promises ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates the joy of dwelling in God's presence. The key verse expresses the blessedness of trusting in God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 85
Psalm 85:10
Mercy and truth are met together
### Why This Verse Beautiful redemption imagery ### Chapter Insight This psalm prays for revival and restoration. The key verse celebrates the meeting of God's mercy and truth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 86
Psalm 86:15
Thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion
### Why This Verse Divine character ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a personal prayer for mercy and guidance. The key verse highlights God's compassion and readiness to forgive. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 87
Psalm 87:3
Glorious things are spoken of thee
### Why This Verse Famous Zion verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates Zion's special place in God's purposes. The key verse anticipates people from all nations belonging to God's city. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 88
Psalm 88:18
Darkness is my closest companion
### Why This Verse Notable lament conclusion ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a lament from the depths of suffering. The key verse demonstrates persistence in prayer even without immediate relief. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 89
Psalm 89:34
My covenant will I not break
### Why This Verse Covenant faithfulness ### Chapter Insight This psalm reflects on God's covenant with David. The key verse emphasizes God's enduring faithfulness despite present difficulties. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 90
Psalm 90:12
Teach us to number our days
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted wisdom verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm, written by Moses, reflects on God's eternity and human frailty. The key verse calls for wisdom in light of life's brevity. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 91
Psalm 91:1
He that dwelleth in the secret place
### Why This Verse Perhaps the most cited protection psalm ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's protection for those who trust Him. The key verse emphasizes security found in dwelling under God's care. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 92
Psalm 92:12
The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree
### Why This Verse Spiritual growth imagery ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God for His faithfulness and righteous rule. The key verse highlights the flourishing of the righteous in God's presence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 93
Psalm 93:1
The LORD reigneth
### Why This Verse Central theme of the psalm ### Chapter Insight This psalm proclaims the Lord's sovereign reign. The key verse emphasizes God's eternal stability and authority. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 94
Psalm 94:19
In the multitude of my thoughts within me
### Why This Verse Comfort in anxiety ### Chapter Insight This psalm appeals to God for justice against the wicked. The key verse affirms that God disciplines and teaches His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 95
Psalm 95:6
O come, let us worship and bow down
### Why This Verse Classic call to worship ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls God's people to worship and obedience. The key verse warns against hardening the heart toward God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 96
Psalm 96:3
Declare His glory among the nations
### Why This Verse Missions emphasis ### Chapter Insight This psalm invites all nations to worship the Lord. The key verse proclaims God's glory among the peoples of the earth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 97
Psalm 97:10
Ye that love the LORD, hate evil
### Why This Verse Moral exhortation ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's universal kingship. The key verse emphasizes joy for those who love righteousness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 98
Psalm 98:4
Make a joyful noise unto the LORD
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted worship verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God for His salvation and righteous judgment. The key verse calls creation itself to rejoice before the Lord. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 99
Psalm 99:5
Exalt ye the LORD our God
### Why This Verse Worship and holiness ### Chapter Insight This psalm exalts God's holiness and justice. The key verse emphasizes worship before a holy God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 100
Psalm 100:4
Enter into His gates with thanksgiving
### Why This Verse One of the most beloved worship verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a joyful call to worship. The key verse celebrates God's goodness, love, and faithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 101
Psalm 101:3
I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes
### Why This Verse Personal holiness ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses commitment to righteous leadership. The key verse highlights integrity in both private and public life. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 102
Psalm 102:25
Of old hast Thou laid the foundation of the earth
### Why This Verse Quoted in Hebrews ### Chapter Insight This psalm contrasts human frailty with God's permanence. The key verse emphasizes God's unchanging nature. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 103
Psalm 103:12
As far as the east is from the west
### Why This Verse One of the most beloved forgiveness verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's mercy and compassion. The key verse calls believers to remember and praise God's benefits. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 104
Psalm 104:24
O LORD, how manifold are Thy works
### Why This Verse Praise for creation ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God as Creator and Sustainer. The key verse highlights God's wisdom displayed throughout creation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 105
Psalm 105:4
Seek the LORD and His strength
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted exhortation ### Chapter Insight This psalm recounts God's faithfulness throughout Israel's history. The key verse emphasizes remembering God's mighty deeds. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 106
Psalm 106:1
O give thanks unto the LORD; for He is good
### Why This Verse Classic praise formula ### Chapter Insight This psalm confesses Israel's repeated failures. The key verse highlights God's mercy despite continual rebellion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 107
Psalm 107:1
O give thanks unto the LORD; for He is good
### Why This Verse Opening thanksgiving refrain ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's deliverance in many circumstances. The key verse calls the redeemed to give thanks for God's goodness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 108
Psalm 108:13
Through God we shall do valiantly
### Why This Verse Victory through God ### Chapter Insight This psalm combines praise and confidence in God's help. The key verse expresses steadfast trust in God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 109
Psalm 109:4
I give myself unto prayer
### Why This Verse David's response to enemies ### Chapter Insight This psalm appeals for justice amid severe opposition. The key verse demonstrates dependence upon God in the face of hostility. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 110
Psalm 110:1
The LORD said unto my Lord
### Why This Verse Most quoted OT verse in the NT ### Chapter Insight This psalm presents the Messiah as King and Priest. The key verse is one of the most frequently quoted Old Testament verses in the New Testament. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 111
Psalm 111:10
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom
### Why This Verse Foundational wisdom text ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God's works and character. The key verse identifies reverence for God as the beginning of wisdom. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 112
Psalm 112:7
He shall not be afraid of evil tidings
### Why This Verse Trust amid uncertainty ### Chapter Insight This psalm describes the blessings of the righteous. The key verse emphasizes stability rooted in trust in God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 113
Psalm 113:3
From the rising of the sun
### Why This Verse Universal praise ### Chapter Insight This psalm exalts God for His greatness and compassion. The key verse highlights God's care for the humble. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 114
Psalm 114:7
Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord
### Why This Verse God's power displayed ### Chapter Insight This psalm recalls God's power during the Exodus. The key verse celebrates God's presence among His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 115
Psalm 115:1
Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us
### Why This Verse Humility and God's glory ### Chapter Insight This psalm contrasts the living God with idols. The key verse emphasizes trusting God rather than human-made substitutes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 116
Psalm 116:15
Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints
### Why This Verse Frequently used at funerals ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses gratitude for God's deliverance. The key verse reflects love for God because He hears prayer. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 117
Psalm 117:2
His merciful kindness is great toward us
### Why This Verse Entire psalm summarized ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls all nations to praise the Lord. The key verse highlights God's enduring mercy and truth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 118
Psalm 118:24
This is the day which the LORD hath made
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted verses in Psalms ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's steadfast love and salvation. The key verse points prophetically to the rejected cornerstone becoming the chief cornerstone. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 119
Psalm 119:105
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet
### Why This Verse Most cited verse from Psalm 119 ### Chapter Insight This psalm exalts God's Word in every aspect of life. The key verse emphasizes storing Scripture in the heart to avoid sin. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 120
Psalm 120:1
In my distress I cried unto the LORD
### Why This Verse Pilgrim prayer ### Chapter Insight This psalm begins the Songs of Ascents with a cry for deliverance. The key verse expresses longing for peace amid conflict. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 121
Psalm 121:1
I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills
### Why This Verse One of the most beloved pilgrimage psalms ### Chapter Insight This psalm expresses confidence in God's continual protection. The key verse emphasizes that help comes from the Lord, the Creator of heaven and earth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 122
Psalm 122:6
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem
### Why This Verse Widely quoted prayer verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates worship in Jerusalem. The key verse highlights the joy of gathering with God's people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 123
Psalm 123:2
Our eyes wait upon the Lord
### Why This Verse Dependence upon God's mercy ### Chapter Insight This psalm looks to God for mercy amid contempt and opposition. The key verse illustrates humble dependence upon God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 124
Psalm 124:8
Our help is in the name of the Lord
### Why This Verse Classic statement of trust in God ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God for deliverance from overwhelming danger. The key verse declares that true help comes from the Lord alone. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 125
Psalm 125:1
They that trust in the LORD shall be as Mount Zion
### Why This Verse Stability through faith ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates the security of those who trust in God. The key verse compares believers to Mount Zion, steadfast and unshaken. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 126
Psalm 126:5
They that sow in tears shall reap in joy
### Why This Verse Classic hope and restoration verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm rejoices in God's restoration of His people. The key verse reflects joy when God reverses seasons of hardship. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 127
Psalm 127:1
Except the LORD build the house
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted family/work verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm teaches dependence upon God's blessing. The key verse reminds believers that labor is futile apart from the Lord. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 128
Psalm 128:1
Blessed is every one that fears the LORD
### Why This Verse Family blessing psalm ### Chapter Insight This psalm describes the blessings of fearing the Lord. The key verse emphasizes the fruitfulness of a God-centered life. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 129
Psalm 129:2
Many a time have they afflicted me
### Why This Verse Perseverance theme ### Chapter Insight This psalm recounts God's faithfulness through repeated affliction. The key verse celebrates God's deliverance from persistent enemies. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 130
Psalm 130:4
There is forgiveness with Thee
### Why This Verse Grace and redemption ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer of repentance and hope. The key verse highlights forgiveness as the basis for reverence toward God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 131
Psalm 131:2
I have quieted my soul
### Why This Verse Humility and contentment ### Chapter Insight This psalm models humility and contentment. The key verse illustrates peaceful trust in God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 132
Psalm 132:8
Arise, O LORD, into Thy resting place
### Why This Verse Ark and temple worship ### Chapter Insight This psalm recalls God's covenant with David. The key verse emphasizes God's commitment to His chosen king and dwelling place. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 133
Psalm 133:1
How good and pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity
### Why This Verse Most famous unity verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates unity among God's people. The key verse highlights the beauty and blessing of harmony. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 134
Psalm 134:2
Lift up your hands in the sanctuary
### Why This Verse Worship exhortation ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls God's servants to continual worship. The key verse encourages praise in the Lord's house. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 135
Psalm 135:6
Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did He
### Why This Verse Divine sovereignty ### Chapter Insight This psalm exalts God's greatness over all idols. The key verse celebrates God's sovereignty and mighty works. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 136
Psalm 136:1
His mercy endureth forever
### Why This Verse Repeated refrain throughout the psalm ### Chapter Insight This psalm repeatedly affirms God's enduring mercy. The key verse highlights God's steadfast love throughout history. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 137
Psalm 137:1
By the rivers of Babylon
### Why This Verse Most recognized exile verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm laments exile in Babylon. The key verse expresses longing for Jerusalem and God's covenant promises. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 138
Psalm 138:8
The LORD will perfect that which concerns me
### Why This Verse Popular promise verse ### Chapter Insight This psalm gives thanks for God's faithfulness. The key verse celebrates God's exaltation of His word and name. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 139
Psalm 139:14
I am fearfully and wonderfully made
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted verses in Psalms ### Chapter Insight This psalm reflects on God's complete knowledge and presence. The key verse marvels at being wonderfully made by God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 140
Psalm 140:13
The upright shall dwell in Thy presence
### Why This Verse Closing confidence ### Chapter Insight This psalm seeks protection from evil people. The key verse emphasizes God's defense of the righteous. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 141
Psalm 141:3
Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted prayer ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a prayer for holiness and protection. The key verse expresses the desire for speech and conduct pleasing to God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 142
Psalm 142:3
When my spirit was overwhelmed within me
### Why This Verse Comfort in distress ### Chapter Insight This psalm is a cry for help during isolation and distress. The key verse identifies God as the believer's refuge. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 143
Psalm 143:10
Teach me to do Thy will
### Why This Verse Prayer for guidance ### Chapter Insight This psalm seeks guidance and deliverance. The key verse emphasizes dependence upon God's Spirit for direction. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 144
Psalm 144:1
Blessed be the LORD my strength
### Why This Verse Praise for divine help ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God as protector and provider. The key verse acknowledges God as the source of strength and victory. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 145
Psalm 145:9
The LORD is good to all
### Why This Verse Universal goodness of God ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's greatness and kingdom. The key verse highlights God's gracious and compassionate character. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 146
Psalm 146:5
Happy is he whose hope is in the LORD
### Why This Verse Trust in God over men ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls believers to place their trust in God rather than human leaders. The key verse contrasts God's faithfulness with human limitations. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 147
Psalm 147:3
He healeth the broken in heart
### Why This Verse One of the most beloved comfort verses ### Chapter Insight This psalm praises God's care for creation and His people. The key verse highlights God's healing and restorative power. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 148
Psalm 148:13
Let them praise the name of the LORD
### Why This Verse Universal praise ### Chapter Insight This psalm calls all creation to praise the Lord. The key verse emphasizes universal worship of the Creator. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 149
Psalm 149:4
The LORD takes pleasure in His people
### Why This Verse Joy in God's favor ### Chapter Insight This psalm celebrates God's victory and the praise of His people. The key verse highlights joyful worship as a response to God's favor. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 150
Psalm 150:6
Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD
### Why This Verse Climactic conclusion of Psalms ### Chapter Insight This psalm concludes the Psalter with a universal call to praise. The key verse summons everything that has breath to praise the Lord. :::
